system.text: Past the last charted jump point: a star no survey lists, and worlds around it where a colony could take root.

lanes: Near the shipping lanes: easy to reach, and easy to find.
Off the lanes: a long way round to find.
Far from any lane: hard to reach, and harder to find.

kinds.name: Ocean world
kinds.text: Water from pole to pole, with island chains where a colony could stand. Fish and storms, and little rock.
kinds.landing: The ship sets down on an island's back, spray across the viewports. The sea runs on to the edge of the world.

kinds.name: Desert world
kinds.text: Sand seas and salt flats over deep seams of ore. Water will be the dear thing, and the storms the dangerous one.
kinds.landing: The ship sets down on a salt flat in a storm of its own dust. When the dust clears, the heat comes in.

kinds.name: Ice world
kinds.text: A frozen crust over old seas. Cold and quiet, and hard to farm.
kinds.landing: The ship settles onto the ice with a long crack, then nothing: wind, and the engines ticking as they cool.

kinds.name: Jungle world
kinds.text: Green to the horizon on rich soil, and most of what lives in it bites.
kinds.landing: The ship burns a clearing to set down in. By morning the green is creeping back.

kinds.name: Barren rock
kinds.text: Airless stone, rich and empty. Whatever the colony needs, it brings or digs.
kinds.landing: The ship sets down on bare stone under a black sky. No air and no weather: the ground, and what is in it.
